additional_info.subject: Re: ID0409526-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P0 170001103] Terminal in factory condition CRM:00642002079
additional_info.body:
Hello Romain,
Could you please elaborate “what is terminal in factory condition?”
The Charger is offline on SCB(XF3) & there is no current logs
the Charger was last online on 12/02/2025 as checked in AWS
Charger needs to be online on SCB so that we can do the troubleshooting.
Following reason for which charger is offline on SCB
1) XF3 router is faulty or No Power in router
2) Ethernet cable Connection in router is disconnected or wrongly connected
3) Router Configuration is changed or wrong configuration in XF3 router
4) No Internet Connection in router ( SIM/WIFI/Ethernet)
5) Internet connection might be available or there is no data.
Could you please let me know is the charger rebooting after every 30%loading when ever turned on or its In On Condition only disconnected from SCB.
Site visit will be required to check the XF3 router.
If required need to carry Spare router
Thank you
Best Regards
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sunil Sharma
Please do not change the subject of this Email when replying to it.
